summary: Typosquat of @openzeppelin/contracts exfiltrates installer credentials and wallet keys to webhook.site on install
details: Package name typosquats the legitimate @openzeppelin/contracts. package.json registers both preinstall and postinstall to run index.js, which on any npm install enumerates process.env for keys shaped like credentials (KEY, TOKEN, SECRET, PRIVATE, MNEMONIC, WALLET, AWS, GITHUB, NPM), reads installer-owned secret files including ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.kube/config, ~/.docker/config.json, ~/.netrc, ~/.npmrc, ~/.gitconfig, gcloud credentials, Solana/NEAR/Sui wallet keys, Foundry keystores, and.env* files in the working directory, and collects host identifiers (hostname, username, cwd, platform, arch, directory listings). The collected blob is POSTed via https.request to the hardcoded anonymous collector https://webhook.site/326b0891-2093-4800-a4c1-686ce3e07b09.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
